messages.sourceEnglish: Review automatic crop plans from your own growing estimates and saved buyer targets.
messages.text: Buyekeza izinhlelo zezitshalo ezizenzakalelayo ezisuselwa ezilinganisweni zakho siqu zokutshala kanye nemigomo yabathengi egciniwe.

messages.sourceEnglish: Check dated nursery tray and surface needs before downloading your review.
messages.text: Hlola ugqoko lwezithombo nezidingo zendawo ezinezinsuku ngaphambi kokulanda ukubuyekeza kwakho.

messages.sourceEnglish: Save your own growing estimates and review capacity and dates for measured beds.
messages.text: Gcina izilinganiso zakho siqu zokutshala bese ubuyekeza umthamo nezinsuku zemibhede yokutshala ekaliwe.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a crop plan from your estimates
messages.text: Buyekeza uhlelo lwezitshalo olususelwa ezilinganisweni zakho

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.text: Umhleli wezitshalo → Uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olususelwa ezilinganisweni zakho

messages.sourceEnglish: Check your saved design, confirm availability and match buyer targets to your growing estimates. Review the proposed cycles and nursery needs; your saved sowings remain unchanged.
messages.text: Hlola umklamo wakho owugcinile, uqinisekise ukutholakala bese ufanisa imigomo yabathengi nezilinganiso zakho zokutshala. Buyekeza imijikelezo ehlongozwayo nezidingo zenkulisa yezitshalo; ukuhlwanyela kwakho okugciniwe kuhlala kungashintshile.

messages.sourceEnglish: Enter your own assumptions, choose a measured bed and review the calculation. Blank values stay missing; the result is an estimate, not local farming approval.
messages.text: Faka imicabango yakho siqu, ukhethe umbhede wokutshala okaliwe bese ubuyekeza izibalo. Amanani angenalutho ahlala engekho; umphumela uyisilinganiso, hhayi ukugunyazwa kokulima kwendawo.
